correctness.rationale: The first-module proof uses the precise Ko--Park rank theorem and equivariant total-motion/Y-exchange exact sequence, with orientation signs induced by spherical prism symmetries. The second-module proof explicitly calculates the signed traces of every fixed vertex pair, edge-vertex and disjoint-edge square, then uses equivariant Euler--Poincaré; all parity and half-turn cases are covered. Character orthogonality proves a genuine removable sign summand. Reproducible exact cellular matrices and group actions corroborate finite cases; they are not used to prove infinitely many cases.

value.rationale: Full representations in two positive homology degrees for every n>=5 form a natural complete family. The quotient contrast, with one rational H2 class retained by D_n but destroyed by adding layer swap, cannot be recovered from nonequivariant Betti numbers; the result is useful for symmetry reductions of graph configuration spaces and exceeds an arbitrary finite census.
